key_highlights: ASX slides on rising oil prices from Hormuz Strait escalation, but energy and large-cap miners rally (BHP, WES, WOC) offsetting losses
Iron ore prices crumble, prompting BHP to consider major operational cuts; copper and gold surge on safe-haven and supply-demand dynamics
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; property industry described as facing a 'GFC moment'; RBA unlikely to intervene
Building company collapse exposes systemic private credit vulnerabilities across Australian construction and finance sectors
Gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Larvotto, Aureka) post strong results; gold at multi-year highs on Trump/geopolitical risk
Gas crisis divides Australian energy industry; El Niño intensifying, threatening agricultural output
Consumer stress deepens: second jobs, mortgage pressure, living standards collapse masked by public sector employment

sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG; copper and gold surge. Multiple gold miners hit milestones (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser inventory build, Larvotto NSW discovery, Aureka $8.9M acquisition).
sectors.implications: Rotate from iron ore exposure to gold and copper names. BHP.AX faces margin compression; gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX, FOR.AX) offer relative strength.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation lifts oil; tanker wars unlikely to suppress prices long-term. Domestic gas crisis creates policy and pricing tension. WES and WOC benefit from higher energy prices.
sectors.implications: Energy names (WES.AX, WOC.AX, SXG.AX) are relative outperformers. Gas supply risk could pressure downstream consumers and agriculture.

sectors.trend: Building company collapse exposes private credit contagion risk. Housing price falls accelerate; RBA constrained from easing. Super access debate (Joyce) signals policy pressure.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk from property and construction. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure. Private credit exposure a key concern.

sectors.trend: Living standards collapse, second-job reliance, car supply crunch raising insurance premiums. Tobacco tax fight adds policy uncertainty. Costco loss hits beverage brands.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX defensive appeal rises. Consumer discretionary under pressure. Insurance (CGU.AX, IAG.AX) faces premium inflation from supply issues.

sectors.trend: $40B NT data centre land grant signals infrastructure buildout. Stokes family retakes Seven Network control. Hyperscaler bonds competing with Treasuries globally.
sectors.implications: Data centre build benefits construction and utilities. Media consolidation (SVA.AX) under Stokes control. Tech remains US-centric; limited ASX direct exposure.

sectors.trend: No major ASX healthcare headlines today. Vaxcyte (PCVX) US vaccine gamble noted. Toowoomba maternity review highlights public health system strain.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) remain defensive anchors. No immediate catalyst.

key_themes: Geopolitical escalation (Hormuz, Trump threats) driving safe-haven flows into gold and oil
Iron ore structural weakness vs. copper/gold strength — commodity rotation underway
Australian property market in accelerated decline; RBA policy dilemma deepens
Private credit and construction sector fragility exposed by building company collapse
Consumer affordability crisis: second jobs, mortgage stress, living standards erosion
El Niño intensifying — agricultural and insurance risk elevated
Gold mining sector in strong cyclical upswing across ASX-listed producers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WES.AX, WOC.AX; diversify into gold miners as inflation hedge
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor bank NPLs (CBA.AX, NAB.AX); avoid private credit-linked instruments

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse impacting BHP/FMG earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX) and copper exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Niño / agricultural and insurance disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor SUG.AX, TNL.AX; insurance names (CGU.AX, IAG.AX) face claims pressure
Maintain AUD hedging; monitor global equity correlation; gold as hedge

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand collapse / living standards decline
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX); reduce discretionary consumer exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX gold miners on safe-haven demand and production milestones
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser inventory build, Larvotto NSW discovery, Aureka acquisition; gold at multi-year highs on geopolitical and Trump risk

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical overweight energy names on Hormuz-driven oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil prices rising; tanker wars unlikely to suppress supply; WES and WOC benefit from higher energy pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Selective copper exposure on supply-demand tightness
opportunities.rationale: Copper prices soaring; structural demand from data centres and energy transition supports medium-term upside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge property and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing falls accelerating, building company collapse, private credit contagion risk; RBA unlikely to intervene

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight iron ore-heavy miners; favour gold rotation
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crumbling; BHP considering major cuts; earnings revision risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase defensive staples and healthcare allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer stress, living standards collapse; defensive sectors offer relative resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank NPL trajectories; reduce leverage
defensive_moves.rationale: Private credit and property stress could flow through to bank credit costs

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and under pressure. Hormuz escalation supports energy but iron ore weakness and property/credit concerns cap upside. Gold miners provide relative strength. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow, risk-off range. VIX elevated but 'sleeping' — complacency risk.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from property correction, consumer affordability, and iron ore demand softness weigh on ASX. Gold and energy offer cyclical support. RBA constrained between property support and inflation. Medium-term rotation from iron ore to gold/copper/energy likely to continue. US midterms and Trump policy add external volatility.

AUD/USD, iron ore, copper, gold, Brent crude prices
RBA policy statements, CPI, retail sales data
US 10Y yield and hyperscaler bond issuance (El-Erian warning)
